description: Salempur me full body checkup package kaise chunein — parameter ki ginti nahi, coverage dekhiye. Kis umar me kaun sa plan, aur package me kya chhoot jaata hai.

takeaways: Package parameter ki ginti se nahi, coverage se chuniye. 80 parameter wala package agar thyroid chhod deta hai to wo 45 parameter wale se kamzor hai.

Paanch cheezein har package me honi chahiye: CBC, sugar, lipid profile, liver function aur kidney function ke saath urine routine. Inke upar thyroid aur vitamin jud jaayein to package se sach me kuch pata chalta hai.
Full body checkup screening hai, ilaaj nahi. Koi shikayat pehle se hai to package ke bharose mat baithiye — doctor ko dikhaiye.
Package hamesha khaali pet hota hai, isliye subah 6 baje ka pehla slot lijiye aur naashta taiyaar rakhiye.
Ghar ke kai log kara rahe hain to sabka slot ek hi rakhiye — ek hi visit me sabka sample ho jaata hai, aur alag-alag karane par kharcha bhi zyada padta hai.

sections.heading: Full Body Checkup In Salempur — Ye Kya Hai, Aur Kya Nahi Hai
sections.lead: Naam "full body" hai, lekin ye poore sharir ki jaanch nahi hoti. Ye screening hai.
blocks: Full body checkup ka matlab ek package hota hai — kuch blood aur urine ke test ek saath, ek hi sample me, ek tay daam par. Iska kaam bimari pakadna nahi hai; iska kaam un cheezon ko jaldi pakadna hai jo chup chaap badh rahi hoti hain. Sugar, cholesterol, thyroid, liver, kidney aur vitamin ki kami — inme se koi bhi shuruaat me kuch mehsoos nahi karati.

Yahi baat sabse zyada galat samjhi jaati hai. "Full body kara liya, sab theek hai" — ye vaakya khatarnak hai. Package me cancer ki jaanch nahi hoti, dil ki bimari ka pakka pata nahi chalta, haddi aur jodon ki jaanch nahi hoti, aur jo cheezein machine par dikhti hain — X-ray, ultrasound, ECG — wo isme aati hi nahi. Wo hamari service me bhi shaamil nahi hain.

Isliye seedha niyam ye hai: koi shikayat pehle se hai to package mat chuniye — doctor ko dikhaiye aur wahi test karaiye jo wo kahe. Package un logon ke liye hai jinhe abhi kuch nahi hai aur jo ek baseline banana chahte hain.

note.title: Screening aur ilaaj alag cheezein hain
note.text: Screening ka matlab hai bina shikayat wale vyakti me chhupi cheez dhoondhna. Ilaaj ka matlab hai maujooda shikayat ka jawab dhoondhna. Package pehla kaam karta hai, doosra nahi. Bukhar hai, dard hai, ya kuch mahino se kamzori hai — to package se shuruaat karna waqt kharab karna hai.

sections.heading: Parameter Ki Ginti Mat Giniye — Ye Paanch Cheezein Dekhiye
sections.lead: Package ki taakat isme hai ki kya-kya shaamil hai, isme nahi ki kitne number chhapte hain.
blocks: Package bechne ka sabse aam tareeka parameter ki ginti hai — 45, 72, 88. Lekin ginti apne aap me kuch nahi batati. Ek package 80 parameter de sakta hai jisme se 30 CBC ke andar ke hi hisse hon, aur thyroid usme ho hi na. Wo package 45 parameter wale se kamzor hai, chahe number bada dikhe.

sections.heading: Affordable Full Body Checkup Packages In Salempur — Daam Kis Baat Par Tay Hota Hai
sections.lead: Sasta aur mehnga package me farak ginti ka nahi, shaamil test ka hota hai.
blocks: Package ka daam teen cheezon par tay hota hai: usme kaunse test hain, unme se kitne mehnge test hain, aur kya usme vitamin jaise test bhi hain. Vitamin D aur B12 apne aap me mehnge test hain — jis package me ye dono hain uska daam badhega hi, aur wo badha hua daam sach me kuch de raha hota hai.

list: Package me bachat sabse zyada hoti hai. Wahi test alag-alag karane par kharcha kai guna ho jaata hai — yahi package ka poora point hai.
Home collection ka koi alag charge nahi hai. Package ka jo daam likha hai, wahi dena hota hai — na visiting charge, na travel charge.
Kasba hone ki wajah se yahan koi alag daam nahi lagta. Rate wahi hain jo baaki sheheron me hain.
Payment sample lene ke waqt hota hai — cash ya UPI se. Pehle se paisa dene ki zaroorat nahi.
Kiraya bhi kharche me giniye. Deoria ya Gorakhpur aane-jaane ka dono taraf ka kiraya aur report lene ka doosra chakkar — kasbe me ye asli bachat hai.

sections.heading: Lipid Profile Test In Salempur — Package Ka Wo Hissa Jo Sabse Zyada Kaam Ka Hai
sections.lead: Yahi ek test hai jiske liye poore package ko khaali pet karna padta hai. Wajah samajh lijiye.
blocks: Lipid Profile me cholesterol aur triglyceride ke chaar-paanch number aate hain — Total Cholesterol, LDL, HDL, aur Triglycerides. Ye dil ki bimari ka sabse jaldi milne wala ishaara hai, aur is ilaake me ye ishaara aksar der se pakda jaata hai kyunki koi lakshan hota hi nahi.

list: Isme fasting lagti hai — 10 se 12 ghante. Poora package isi ek test ki wajah se khaali pet hota hai.
Triglycerides khaane par sabse zyada upar-neeche hote hain. Ek din pehle bahut tala-bhuna khaya ho to number badha hua aa sakta hai — isliye ek din pehle aam khana khaiye, na zyada parhez, na daawat.
LDL ko "kharaab" aur HDL ko "achha" kehna aasan hai lekin adhoora hai. Doctor teenon ko saath me dekhta hai, aur sugar aur BP ke saath milakar dekhta hai.
Ek din pehle sharaab bilkul nahi. Triglycerides is par seedha badh jaate hain aur report ka matlab bigad jaata hai.
Sugar ki dawa chal rahi hai to lipid saal me ek baar zaroor — ye wahi test hai jo follow-up me sabse zyada chhoota hai.

sections.heading: Package Book Karne Se Pehle Chaar Cheezein Taiyaar Rakhiye
sections.lead: Package ek hi sample me ho jaata hai, lekin us ek sample ki taiyaari maayne rakhti hai.
blocks: Package ki booking me sabse zyada gadbad slot aur fasting par hoti hai. Chaar cheezein pehle se tay kar lijiye, phir visit bilkul seedhi rehti hai.

list: Slot — subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot. Package hamesha khaali pet hota hai, aur der ke slot ka matlab lambi bhookh hai.
Raat ka khana — 9 baje tak. Isse 10 se 12 ghante apne aap poore ho jaate hain. Beech me sirf saada paani; chai, doodh, biscuit ya paan fasting tod dete hain.
Naashta — pehle se taiyaar rakhiye. Sample ke turant baad kha sakte hain, aur bujurgon aur bachchon ke liye ye zaroori hai.
Dawa aur haalat — jo dawa chal rahi hai, aur pregnancy, khoon patla karne wali dawa, ya nas ki purani dikkat — ye sab booking ke waqt bata dijiye. Niyamit dawa apne aap band mat kijiye.

blocks: Ek baat aur, jo aksar poochhi jaati hai: periods ke dinon me package karana theek hai ya nahi. Blood ke test par iska koi khaas asar nahi padta, lekin urine ka sample us waqt saaf nahi aata. Isliye package me urine routine hai to do-teen din baad ka slot lijiye — aur agar rukna theek nahi lagta to booking ke waqt bata dijiye.
Ghar ke kai log kara rahe hain to sabka slot ek hi rakhiye — ek hi visit me sabka sample ho jaata hai. Jinke test me fasting nahi lagti, unhe bhookha rakhne ki zaroorat nahi.

sections.lead: Package ki report lambi hoti hai. Isliye padhne ka ek kram hona chahiye.
blocks: 72 ya 88 parameter ki report kholte hi kuch na kuch laal zaroor dikhta hai — aur wahin se bewajah ki ghabrahat shuru hoti hai. Ek tay kram se dekhiye.

Phir wo paanch cheezein jo package ka asli kaam hain: sugar, lipid, liver, kidney aur CBC. Baaki sab inke saath hi padha jaata hai.
Har number ke bagal me us lab ki apni reference range dekhiye. Doosri lab ki range se mat milaiye.

Pichhle saal ki report saath rakhiye. Package ka poora faayda tabhi milta hai jab do saal ki report saath me padhi jaayein — disha number se zyada batati hai.
Vitamin ki kami nikli ho to apne mann se high-dose goli shuru mat kijiye. Khuraak kami ki gehrai par tay hoti hai; report dikha kar likhwa lijiye.

faqs.question: Salempur me full body checkup me kya-kya aata hai?
faqs.answer: Kam se kam paanch cheezein honi chahiye: CBC, blood sugar, lipid profile, liver function test, aur kidney function test ke saath urine routine. Bade package me thyroid, HbA1c aur Vitamin D tatha B12 bhi jud jaate hain. Kaunse package me kya-kya hai, uski poori list service page par likhi hai — parameter ki ginti se zyada yahi list dekhni chahiye.

faqs.question: Full body checkup ke liye khaali pet rehna zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Haan, zyadatar package fasting maangte hain — 10 se 12 ghante. Wajah lipid profile aur fasting sugar hain. Isliye subah 6 se 8 ka pehla slot lijiye, raat ka khana 9 baje tak kar lijiye, beech me sirf saada paani, aur naashta taiyaar rakhiye. 14 ghante se zyada bhookhe rehna faayda nahi, nuksan karta hai.

faqs.question: Package me price kya hai — is page par kyun nahi likha?
faqs.answer: Har package aur har test ka daam service page ki rate list par ek hi jagah likha hai, taaki wo kabhi purana na pada rahe aur alag-alag page par alag na dikhe. Home collection uske upar free hai — na visiting charge, na travel charge. Payment sample lene ke waqt cash ya UPI se hota hai, aur rate confirmation call par bhi confirm ho jaata hai.

faqs.question: Zyada parameter wala package hamesha behtar hota hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Ginti apne aap me kuch nahi batati — ek package 80 parameter de sakta hai jisme thyroid ho hi na, aur wo 45 parameter wale se kamzor hoga. Do package milaate waqt dono ki list saamne rakhiye aur dekhiye ki CBC, sugar, lipid, liver, kidney, thyroid aur vitamin me se kya-kya hai. Jo chhoot gaya, uska pata agle saal chalta hai.

faqs.question: Ghar ke chaar log ek saath full body checkup kara sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, aur yahi sabse aasan tareeka hai. Sabki booking ek hi slot me kar dijiye — ek hi visit me sabka sample ho jaata hai. Har vyakti ka naam, umar aur package alag likhwaiye. Jinke test me fasting nahi lagti unhe bhookha rakhne ki zaroorat nahi. Report har vyakti ki alag PDF me aati hai.

faqs.question: Full body checkup se cancer ya dil ki bimari pakad me aa jaati hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Package screening hai — wo un cheezon ko jaldi pakadta hai jo blood aur urine me dikhti hain: sugar, cholesterol, thyroid, liver, kidney aur vitamin ki kami. Cancer ki screening, dil ki jaanch, aur X-ray ya ultrasound par dikhne wali cheezein isme nahi aatin, aur wo hamari service me bhi shaamil nahi hain. Koi shikayat ho to doctor ko dikhaiye.

faqs.question: Package saal me kitni baar karana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Umar 30 se kam aur koi shikayat nahi — do saal me ek baar kaafi hai. 30 ke upar saal me ek baar, aur har baar lagbhag usi mahine me, taaki tulna seedhi rahe. Ek-do mahine me dobara karana bekaar hai; number itni jaldi badalte nahi. Sugar, BP ya thyroid ki dawa chal rahi ho to follow-up alag chalta hai — use package se mat badaliye.

faqs.question: Periods ke dinon me full body checkup kara sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Blood ke test par iska koi khaas asar nahi padta, lekin urine ka sample un dinon saaf nahi aata. Package me urine routine shaamil hota hai, isliye do-teen din baad ka slot lena behtar hai. Rukna theek na lagta ho to booking ke waqt bata dijiye — us hisaab se tay kar liya jaayega.
